Commentary.Commentary: It's game on time! India Women players stride out to the middle. Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney are the openers for Australia Women. Jhulan Goswami will start the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...

So, India Women have declared on 135/3. A total of 7 overs were bowled after Tea and a total of 29 runs have been added to the team's total. The target for Australia Women is now 272 and there are still as many as 32 overs left in the play. Safe to say that the game is definitely heading towards a draw as for Australia to chase down this stiff target, they would have to come out all guns blazing and score close to 8.5 runs per over which seems unlikely but we never know as they do have the depth in their batting order. The historic pink-ball Test match is taking spicy turns every now and then and let's hope it takes another one. Will India Women have an outside chance scalping 10 wickets in 32 overs? Or will Australia Women go for the win and bring their T20 mode on? A draw still looks the most possible answer.
Flighted delivery, on off and Sharma defends it out.
Fuller one, on off and swept away nicely to wide long on for a single.
On off and turns back in a long away. raut looks to glance but misses.
FOUR! Nicely flighted and Punam Raut skips down the track to muscle it into the long on fence. Good shot.
Similar delivery to the previous one and Raut defends it on the leg side.

Very full and around off. Raut digs it out to mid off.
Nicely flighted, on middle and leg. Raut nudges it to mid-wicket.
Pushed quicker through the air and outside off. Left alone by Punam Raut.
Down the leg side and Deepti Sharma paddles it down to fine leg for a single.

On middle, blocked out.

OUT! LBW! Georgia Wareham gets her first Test wicket. What a moment for her. She bowls a loopy ball, on leg. Shafali Verma looks to defend off the back foot but misses. She gets rapped on the pads. Georgia Wareham appeals for an LBW and the umpire raises his finger. A big wicket and Georgia Wareham is delighted.  Deepti Sharma walks out to bat now.
Short and wide outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
Loopy ball, on off. Raut skips down the track and drills it to long off for a single.
Short and outside off, Raut punches it towards covers.
Short and on leg, Raut blocks it out on the leg side.
The umpires have gone upstairs for a run out appeal. The replay shows that Shafali Verma's bat was in the crease and the decision on the big screen is NOT OUT.
A full toss on middle, drilled to long on for a single.
Short and on leg, Verma goes back and punches it back to the bowler.
Flighted ball on middle, Shafali Verma gets low and tries to sweep but gets hit on the shoulders.
Slightly short on off, Raut taps it towards covers.
On off, Raut defends it right under her eyes.
FOUR! Nicely played! A full toss on middle, Punam Raut whacks it towards deep mid-wicket for another boundary.
Floats it up, on middle, the ball stays a little low. Raut blocks it out.
FOUR! Slower through the air, outside off. Punam Raut caresses it through covers for a boundary.
Drops it short, on leg. Raut defends it out off the back foot.
Who will bowl from the other end? Georgia Wareham, the debutant gets the ball for the first time in the second innings.
On the pads, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.

Tosses it up, on off. Raut watchfully blocks it out.
FOUR! Lovely shot! A full toss on off, Punam Raut dances down the track and smashes it through covers for a boundary.
Loopy ball, on off. Raut defends it out.

We are back for the final session! Australia Women players are making their way out in the middle. Punam Raut and Shafali Verma to continue their innings.  Ashleigh Gardner to also continue with her off-spin.
... DAY 4, SESSION 3 ...

Another gripping session of Test match cricket comes to an end. This was another session which belonged to India Women but have they left it too late to force a result? We'll find out about that soon but let's take a look at what happened in this session. After an early spell of good pace bowling from Ellyse Perry and Darcie Brown, the India Women openers, Mandhana and Verma decided to step on the gas. They put on a steady partnership of 70 runs before Sophie Molineux got rid of Smriti Mandhana, courtesy of a brilliant catch from Ashleigh Gardner. And it was Gardner who got the second breakthrough soon after and sent Yastika Bhatia packing. Since then, Shafali Verma has brough up another half-century and Punam Raut has given her ample support but the flow of runs has been stemmed by the Aussie spinners. India Women end the session with 106 runs on the board and the lead is now stretched to 242 runs. Will India Women declare and try to go for the win or will they keep on batting? Find out soon as the final session of the match starts at 7:35 pm local (9:35 am GMT).

FOUR! FIFTY! Loopy ball on middle, Shafali Verma smashes it straight down the ground towards long on for a boundary. This has been a superb knock from her so far. Brings up her half century in style as well. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 4.

Flighted delivery, on off and Verma plays it with soft hands towards silly mid on.

Flatter one, on middle. Raut blocks it out.
On middle and worked to long on for a single.
Beaten! Beautifully flighted delivery from Gardner. Outside off and this one bounces after pitching as well. Verma looks to block but gets undone by the flight and bounce.
Tossed up, on off and nudges towards cover.

NOT OUT! On the pads, Shafali Verma tickles it to fine leg for a couple of runs. The fielder throws the ball to the keeper who whips the bails off. A run out appeal is sent upstairs and the replay shows Shafali Verma was well inside the crease.
Outside off, tapped to point.

On off, played to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up, on middle. Punam Raut drives it back to the bowler.
Full again, on off. Shafali Verma pushes it to long on for a single.

Punam Raut walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! BOWLED! Ashleigh Gardner strikes! She tosses this one nicely, on middle. Yastika Bhatia puts a big stride forward and tries to defend. She misses the ball completely though. The ball goes through the gate and rattles the furniture behind. So the idea to promote Yastika Bhatia up the order doesn't work and India Women lose their second wicket.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a peach of a catch from Ashleigh Gardner! This is tossed up in the slot and Smriti Mandhana gets down on one knee looking to slog. Mandhana gets enough elevation on it and the ball seems to be going on the bounce and into the wide long on fence. Ashleigh Gardner runs in from deep mid-wicket and launches a dive to her right and pouches it. Sophie Molineux strikes rightaway and can the Aussies now get back into this match?
Commentary.Howout: c Ashleigh Gardner b Sophie Molineux

Commentary.Commentary: Slower delivery, looped up and on off. Mandhana rocks back to defend.

Nicely tossed up, on off. Verma pushes it to the left of the bowler.
Quicker delivery, around off. Verma defends it out.
Sophie Molineux to have a go now.

In the air and safe again. This is the second time Mandhana has top-edged the short ball. Banged in on middle and Mandhana looks to pull. The ball goes off the top edge and lands in front of the filelder racing in from the mid-wicket fence. They get the single.
Another short ball, outside off. Verma makes room and hits it tennis style towards deep mid-wicket. They take a single.

Good-length ball, on middle and leg. Shafali Verma tucks it off her hips onto the leg side and picks up a single.
A well directed short ball, on off and angling in. Verma sways away from it.

DRINKS! Australia Women started off nicely with the ball as Ellyse Perry and Darcie Brown kept things tight in the first few overs. Since then, the opening pair of Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma have motored along and are right on top of things. Can they now step on the gas a bit more and force the issue? We'll find out soon.
Good-length ball, on off. Mandhana blocks it out off the back foot.

Length ball, outside off. Mandhana cuts it towards covers.
On the pads, Mandhana defends it on the leg side.
On a length around off, Mandhana looks to play across the line but misses.
Good-length ball, outside off. Mandhana looks to cut but misses.
Annabel Sutherland comes on to bowl for the first time in this innings.
FOUR! Aggression from Verma and bingo. Short ball again on leg, this time Shafali Verma gets into the line of the ball and slaps it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. 50 up for India Women.
Length ball on leg, Verma looks to work it on the leg side but fails to connect.
An action replay of the previous delivery as Shafali Verma ducks.
Short ball on leg, Shafali Verma ducks under it.

Length ball on leg, Verma looks to flick but misses. The ball brushes off her pads and carries through. Stella Campbell and Alyssa Healy put up an appeal for caught behind but nothing from the umpire.
FOUR! Classy shot! Fuller in length, on middle. Verma drives it through mid off for a boundary.

Fuller in length, on off. Verma prods and drives it to mid off.

Good-length ball, outside off and tapped to short cover.

Fuller in length, outside off. Verma creams it through covers for a brace.

Short of a length outside off. Verma hops and cuts it straight to backward point. She just takes off for the single without giving Mandhana a call.
